steps.text: Open scan-04xx.pdf in Preview and read the Document Record fields.
Append a CSV row for the scan with original_file, normalized new_filename, date, amount, type, status and notes.
Flag as duplicate when vendor/date/amount matches an already-filed row.
Flag as review needed when amount exceeds 500.
Use UNKNOWN-DATE placeholder and note missing date when date is unreadable, but still file the row.
Verify renamed files appear in the inbox folder with the normalized filenames from tracker.csv.

variations: Normal case: date/amount/type all legible -> status 'filed'.
Duplicate case (scan-0417): same vendor/date/amount already filed -> status 'duplicate', original file not renamed, note cites the matching prior filename.
High-value case (scan-0418, 780.00 EUR Studio Equipment): amount over 500 -> status 'review needed', note 'over 500'; no further action on this item found in captured evidence.
Missing-date case (scan-0415): date unreadable -> new_filename uses 'UNKNOWN-DATE' prefix, status still 'filed', note 'missing date'.
Type sometimes inferred from an external client list rather than the document itself (scan-0420 note: 'type from client list').
